subject.why: The tracking radar dish is immediately recognisable, complete with its dish, central feed horn with glowing red tip, and chunky motorized base.

category.why: The dish is grounded firmly on a wide band of stylized green grass with gentle rolling hills and bright sky behind it, matching Category 4 requirements.

clean.why: There are no text elements, borders, UI overlays, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The subject is heroically framed from a low angle, well-centred with comfortable margins on the top and sides, and firmly grounded at the base.

colour.why: Bright, vibrant, and sunny palette with clean separation between the white/red dish, the green turf, and the vivid blue sky.

detail.why: Shapes and mechanical components are simplified into chunky, clean forms without noisy micro-details or cluttered extra props.

style.why: Rendered with smooth satin volumes, soft lighting, and clean curves that perfectly match the established game style seen in the references.
